newsitem.title: UK: Wm. Morrison links with Midland for banking.
newsitem.headline: Wm. Morrison links with Midland for banking.

text.p: William Morrison Supermarkets Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed a strategic alliance with Midland Bank Plc, part of HSBC Holdings, to provide banking and financial services to customers in store.
It said in a statement that the deal would provide the first full-service bank branch within a supermarket.
The first "Midland at Morrisons" branch would open in the supermarket chain's Bradford, northern England, store in May, the company said.

A "Midland at Morrisons" savings account will be introduced later in the year, the company said, and the two companies would work together to offer "exclusive promotions and incentives" to customers while branches will be open at the same times as the supermarket, including public holidays.

Morrisons is the latest in a line of supermarkets which have teamed up with banks to offer finanical services to customers. Market leader Tesco has linked up with Royal Bank of Scotland while J. Sainsbury has launched Sainsbury's Bank with Bank of Scotland.
Safeway has joined forces with Abbey National to provide customers with financial services.
